entries.docs/.vitepress/config.mts: The VitePress configuration of the documentation site: make docs runs vitepress build docs, which loads it.
entries.examples/showcase/*.mts: The builder of the example site: make showcase, showcase-compile, typed-generator, showcase-*-check and bench run these scripts by path.
entries.examples/showcase/adapters/typescript.ts: The TypeScript adapter of the showcase: scripts/check-showcase-contract.mts and examples/showcase/benchmark-modes.mts run it by path.
entries.examples/showcase/adapters/javascript.mj: The JavaScript adapter of the showcase: scripts/check-showcase-contract.mts and examples/showcase/benchmark-modes.mts run it by path.
entries.tests/runner/*.mts: The cross-language runners: make conformance, conformance-generated-*, delimiter-matrix, function-contract-check and function-inventory-check run them by path.
entries.tests/browser/{playwright.config.ts,serv: The browser test: tests/browser/run.mts (make test-browser) starts server.mts by path and Playwright, which reads playwright.config.ts.
entries.examples/showcase/adapters/generated/**/: The generated programs and contract declarations of the showcase: scripts/generate-showcase-contract.mts and the compiler write them, and their exports are the API that a host of a generated program imports, of which the showcase adapters use a part.
entries.examples/site/scenarios/react-boundary/r: The site shows it as the react-boundary integration source (scenario.json integrationFiles); make typecheck checks it with examples/site/scenarios/tsconfig.json.

ignore.packages/ts/src/ast-validator.mjs: The AST validator that scripts/generate-ast-validator.mts generates with ajv standalone validation code (make ast-validator): esbuild wraps the CommonJS module of ajv/dist/runtime that the code requires, whose exports.default knip reads as an unused export of the file.

binaries.gmake: GNU Make of Homebrew: tests/scripts/toolchain-files.test.mts runs the recipes with it where the make of the machine is the GNU Make 3.81 of macOS.

packages/ts.reason: The npm package @polyspec/template, a workspace of the root package.json.

entries.src/index.ts: The main entry of the package, which tsup builds into dist/index.mjs (tsup.config.ts).
entries.src/render.ts: The entry @polyspec/template/render of the package, which tsup builds into dist/render.mjs (tsup.config.ts).
entries.src/node/index.ts: The entry @polyspec/template/node of the package, which tsup builds into dist/node.mjs (tsup.config.ts).

packages/codemirror.reason: The npm package @polyspec/template-codemirror, a workspace of the root package.json.

entries.tests/browser/page.ts: The page script of the browser test: tests/browser/setup.ts, the global setup of the Playwright configuration, bundles it by path with esbuild.

packages/vscode.reason: The VS Code extension polyspec-template, a workspace of the root package.json.

entries.src/extension.ts: The entry of the extension: scripts/build-package.mts bundles it with esbuild into dist/extension.cjs, the main of package.json.
entries.tests/integration/run.mjs: make test-vscode-integration runs it by path.
entries.tests/integration/suite/index.cjs: tests/integration/run.mjs passes it to VS Code as --extensionTestsPath.
